title: Request Microscope: Live Payload Inspector & Error Clustering Timeline
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design a focused debugging surface inside Redwood Console for investigating failed requests at both cohort and single-request levels. The Request Microscope combines a time-series error clustering timeline, retry-cohort selector, and a live payload inspector that surfaces request/response headers, tokenized delta, kv-cache snapshots, and structured tool-call arguments. This ticket covers low-fidelity exploration, high-fidelity prototype, and a lightweight usability review with PM and Eng before handing off to frontend implementation. Goal is to reduce mean time-to-diagnose for sev2+ incidents and provide engineers clear next actions (replay, pin model variant, export payload).
acceptance_criteria: A1: Timeline view shows clustered error bands by taxonomy (auth, rate-limit, model-internal, infra) over selectable time windows and can filter by model, route, and customer tier.
A2: Retry-cohort selector lists grouped requests retried within X minutes and exposes retry metadata (backoff, status codes, failed attempt count).
A3: Payload inspector pane can render JSON, protobuf, and base64 payloads; supports byte-level diff against a chosen baseline request.
A4: Prototype includes interactions for exporting a single request payload and for triggering a safe read-only replay request link for engs with proper RBAC checks.
A5: Usability review feedback from PM and ENG captured and either addressed or triaged in follow-ups.
A6: Handoff package includes component spec, accessibility checklist, and annotated Figma slices for responsive breakpoints.
A7: No PII is exposed by default in payload preview; sensitive fields are masked per security guidance.
reviews: 2026-03-09 PM review (Jonah Patel): prefers a compact timeline with drivetrain to break down clusters by cause — suggested 'zoom to sample' interaction.
2026-03-10 Eng review (Lina Moreno): called out backend dependency on aggregated error-tags (ENG-2201) and recommended progressive disclosure for KV cache dumps to avoid perf regressions.
2026-03-12 Security review (Priya Shah): flagged PII masking and KMS access gating; requested an additional checkbox to redact request bodies in exports.
2026-03-13 Design critique (team): accepted layout changes to make payload inspector collapsible and added a lightweight histogram for token-length distribution per request cluster.
design_notes: Trade-off: Inline full payload vs preview + download. Chose preview with 'expand full payload' to avoid initial heavy renders and to support large batch cohorts.
Decision: Use a vertical split for wide screens (timeline left, payload right) and stacked cards for narrow screens to preserve trace context.
Accessibility: All controls will be keyboard-accessible; diff view will provide a text-only summary for screen readers.
Telemetry: Wire events for 'open_inspector', 'export_payload', 'trigger_replay' to tie UX actions to incident MTTR metrics.
Performance guardrails: limit cohort preview to 50 samples and lazy-load additional items on scroll.
